Reason behind the surge in Chinese A-share CCL stocks:

>>Shenzhen MLS Co., Ltd. / MLS Co., Ltd. (https://t.co/dl7hLHHqvV) raises PCB prices by 20% across all product lines

• Xinyu MLS Electronics Co., Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of MLS Co., Ltd., recently stated that due to rising prices of glass fiber cloth, a key raw material, CCL prices — which are essential for PCB production — have continued to rise sharply, while supply remains tight.

• As a result, the cost of copper-clad laminates, a key raw material for PCBs, has increased significantly. After careful review, the company decided to raise PCB prices by 20% across all product lines starting June 12, 2026.
